decks.notes: The main focus of this deck is to control the game through counterspells and removal spells, utilizing cards like Force of Will, Swords to Plowshares, and Teferi, Time Raveler to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck also includes cards like Back to Basics and Magus of the Moon to further hinder the opponent's mana development. With card draw spells like Ponder and Brainstorm, the deck aims to keep the hand full and consistently have answers to threats. Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student and Thundertrap Trainer provide additional card advantage and utility options.

This deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with powerful creatures and then reanimating them for a quick and devastating win. It utilizes cards like Entomb and Reanimate to cheat creatures into play early on, while also disrupting opponents with cards like Thoughtseize and Force of Will. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with big threats like Archon of Cruelty and Murktide Regent, while also providing some versatility with cards like Brazen Borrower and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student. The deck is designed to be fast and aggressive, aiming to win the game before the opponent has a chance to respond effectively.

This deck focuses on utilizing control elements to manipulate the game state and gain incremental advantages over the opponent. It seeks to establish a strong presence on the battlefield through ramping and card advantage while disrupting the opponent's strategy with counterspells and removal spells. The inclusion of the companion Yorion, Sky Nomad allows for additional card advantage and flexibility in the deck's strategy. By leveraging a combination of ramp, card draw, and disruption, this deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver the opponent to secure victory.

This deck aims to disrupt opponents while quickly deploying threats to control the tempo of the game. The deck plays a mix of disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Force of Will to disrupt opponents' game plans, while also utilizing efficient removal like Fatal Push. The deck also includes powerful threats like Murktide Regent and Nethergoyf to pressure opponents and close out the game quickly. By balancing disruption and threats, this deck seeks to stay ahead of opponents and maintain control of the game's pace in order to secure a win.

The deck focuses on aggressive gameplay with a mix of blue, green, and white cards. Utilizing powerful creatures like Molt Tender and Ice-Fang Coatl to quickly control the board while also having access to powerful cards like Natural Order and Force of Will to disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck also has a toolbox aspect with Green Sun's Zenith to search for key creatures like Uro, Titan of Nature's Wrath or Atraxa, Grand Unifier. The inclusion of Teferi, Time Raveler helps to protect the board and maintain tempo, making it a versatile and powerful aggro deck in the Legacy format.

Utilize efficient disruption and card advantage to control the game while deploying threats to pressure the opponent. Use cards like Thoughtseize, Daze, and Force of Will to disrupt the opponent's game plan, while leveraging cards like Brainstorm, Ponder, and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student to ensure consistent draws. Play aggressive threats like Murktide Regent, Brazen Borrower, and Nethergoyf to quickly close out the game. Wasteland and Orcish Bowmasters help to disrupt the opponent's mana base, while Fatal Push provides efficient removal. The deck aims to maintain a balanced tempo and take advantage of opponent's vulnerabilities.

The deck focuses on using aggressive creatures and disruptive elements such as Blood Moon and Chalice of the Void to control the battlefield and overwhelm the opponent. By utilizing powerful creatures like Magus of the Moon and Fury, along with fast mana acceleration from Chrome Mox and Simian Spirit Guide, the deck aims to quickly establish board presence and disrupt the opponent's game plan. With a strong mana base and versatile removal spells like Sundering Eruption, the deck looks to capitalize on its aggressive strategy and close out games efficiently.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly fill up the graveyard with powerful creatures using cards like Entomb and Reanimate, and then bring them back onto the battlefield quickly and efficiently. By utilizing cards like Thoughtseize and Force of Will to disrupt the opponent's game plan, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Atraxa, Grand Unifier. The deck also includes card draw and filtering spells like Brainstorm and Ponder to ensure consistency and efficiency in executing the combo.

This deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with powerful creatures and then bringing them back into play with cards like Reanimate and Animate Dead. It utilizes disruptive spells like Thoughtseize and Force of Will to protect its combo pieces and control the game. The deck also includes cards that can generate card advantage, such as Brainstorm and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student. Additionally, it has access to lands like Wasteland to disrupt the opponent's mana base. The key strategy is to efficiently reanimate game-winning creatures while disrupting the opponent's game plan.

This deck focuses on utilizing disruptive spells like Inquisition of Kozilek, Thoughtseize, and Force of Will to control the opponent's hand and board while maintaining a fast tempo with efficient creatures like Barrowgoyf and Murktide Regent. The deck also includes removal spells like Fatal Push and Lightning Bolt to deal with threats. Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student provides card advantage and manipulation, while Nihil Spellbomb disrupts graveyard strategies. The mana base is optimized for consistent casting of spells, allowing the deck to apply pressure and disrupt opponents efficiently.

This deck focuses on using Nadu, Winged Wisdom as a key combo piece to generate card advantage and control. It includes cards like Misty Rainforest, Brainstorm, and Ponder to set up draws and find combo pieces quickly. With Nomads en-Kor and Stock Up to protect Nadu, the deck aims to set up powerful plays like Green Sun's Zenith or Natural Order to bring out game-winning creatures like Bristly Bill or Atraxa, Grand Unifier. By utilizing efficient tutoring, counterspells, and card draw, the deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver opponents in a Legacy format.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly fill your graveyard with high-value creatures using cards like Entomb and Brainstorm, then reanimate them onto the battlefield using spells like Reanimate and Animate Dead. This combo strategy aims to bring powerful creatures like Murktide Regent and Archon of Cruelty into play early in the game, overwhelming your opponent with threats. The deck also includes disruptive spells like Thoughtseize and Force of Will to protect your combo pieces and control the board, while Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student provides card advantage and additional graveyard filling.

This deck aims to quickly fill the graveyard with powerful creatures using cards like Entomb and Reanimate, while disrupting the opponent's strategy with cards like Thoughtseize and Force of Will. The key strategy is to bring back a high-impact creature like Archon of Cruelty or Atraxa, Grand Unifier from the graveyard to the battlefield early in the game, overwhelming the opponent and securing a victory. The deck also utilizes counterspells and card draw to protect its combo pieces and maintain momentum throughout the game.

The deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with powerful creatures using cards like Entomb and Reanimate. It also includes disruption with cards like Thoughtseize and Force of Will to protect the combo. The goal is to efficiently reanimate a game-winning threat like Archon of Cruelty or Atraxa, Grand Unifier while controlling the opponent's resources with counter spells and disruptive creatures. The deck aims to win the game quickly and decisively by overwhelming the opponent with powerful threats that are difficult to deal with.

The main idea of this deck is to quickly and efficiently get out powerful creatures like Emrakul, the Aeons Torn or Atraxa, Grand Unifier onto the battlefield using cards like Show and Tell and Sneak Attack. By using various counterspells like Force of Will, Flusterstorm, and Spell Pierce, the deck can protect its combo pieces and disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck also includes cards like Lotus Petal and Chrome Mox to accelerate mana production, allowing for explosive plays early in the game. Ultimately, the goal is to overwhelm the opponent with massive creatures and win the game quickly.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly mill yourself by casting a large number of spells in order to fill your graveyard with creatures like Narcomoeba and Poxwalkers. Once your graveyard is full, you can use cards like Dread Return or Reanimate to bring back powerful creatures from the graveyard, like Thassa's Oracle or Undercity Informer, to win the game instantly. The deck utilizes a combination of fast mana and disruption spells to establish a quick combo and end the game before your opponent has a chance to react.
